mapper.select: SELECT member.memberid, member.membername, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(point) FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark WHERE blackmark.memberid = member.memberid AND blackmark.branchid = member.branchid AND cancelyn = 'N' AND regdate > LAST_DAY(NOW() - interval 1 month) AND regdate <= LAST_DAY(NOW()) ), 0) penalty FROM ttokssaemdb.member member, ttokssaemdb.parents parents WHERE parents.parentid = #{memberid} AND parents.memberid = member.memberid ORDER BY membername

SELECT member.memberid, member.membername, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(point) FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark WHERE blackmark.memberid = member.memberid AND blackmark.branchid = member.branchid AND cancelyn = 'N' AND regdate > LAST_DAY(NOW() - interval 1 month) AND regdate <= LAST_DAY(NOW()) ), 0) penalty FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.branchid = #{branchid} AND member.type = 'S' AND member.classyn = 'Y' ORDER BY membername
